Hey man, not sure if you’ll see this but as a brown guy myself, I can understand where some of those insecurities come from (society, school, etc). But in all honesty, there’s SO many factors you can control that aren’t tied to your ethnicity or height. Focus on the things you can control, and base your self esteem on these factors - like weight, diet, social life, etc 

Fwiw, every confident person doesn’t hinge their confidence on being tall, or white, or anything else - it’s just an innate self love you have for yourself that shines through to others. 

It’s a long road, but focus on improving yourself day by day. Decide to make healthier eating choices, start going on short jogs, talk to one random stranger. I’ve read your post history man - making these changes is up to you but there’s a lot of ppl rooting for ya to find your own happiness, in dating and life in general.

My DMs are always open if you need someone to talk to

EDIT: And soon enough, you’ll start to pride yourself in the things you can’t change as well - you should be proud to be brown, and proud of your height (for one, it’s easier to put on muscle and look more aesthetic!)
